## Variables

```go
var (
    // ErrTimerAlreadyRunning is returned in the case that
    // a double run is called on a specific timer.
    ErrTimerAlreadyRunning = errors.New("timer already active")

    // ErrTimerNotRunning si returned on a double shutdown.
    ErrTimerNotRunning = errors.New("timer not running")
)
```

```go
var (
    // ErrInvalidRSAData is the state that happens, when the rsa data
    // is not valid PEM encoding.
    ErrInvalidPEMData = errors.New("data is not valid pem encoding")

    // ErrInvalidPEMHeader is the error returned, when during
    // parsing an unsupported PEM heder is used.
    ErrInvalidPEMHeader = errors.New("invalid PEM header please use `RSA PRIVATE KEY` instead")
)
```

ErrSemaphoreAtLimit will be returned once there is no more space left for a new arrival

```go
var ErrSemaphoreAtLimit = errors.New("the semaphore is all ready at it's limit")
```

```go
}
```


Release will decrement the counter by until 0\. If there is no more already is zero\, this function will return an error\.
